Questions

Good questions. Straight answers.

Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Enrollment for Rock the Fall closes Monday night. If you're on the fence, one of these is probably why.

I'm out of shape. Is this for me?

Yes. There are beginner-friendly programs, and every workout can be scaled to your level. Winners are chosen by transformation and participation, not by who's already fittest.

Do I need a gym?

No. Choose Home Workouts or Travel & Bodyweight, or train with any program that fits your setup. Every program counts.

What if I miss a day?

Nothing happens. Pick back up the next day. Winners are chosen on their overall transformation and how they show up in the community, not on a perfect streak.

What do I actually get?

Every program, workout, and coaching video in the app. Mobility and recovery sessions. Simple nutrition guidance. And over $300 in guides: the Flexible Dieting Guide, Fast Food Guide, Macro Recipe Book, Supplement Guide, Perfect Week Workbook, and Muscle Building Guide.

Should I do the $50 or the $149?

The $50 challenge gets you Rock the Fall and 10 weeks of app access. The $149 yearly membership gets you 12 months and three challenges, including this one. That works out to less than $13 a month. Both are eligible for the $2,000 prize.

What if it's not for me?

If you're not happy in the first 7 days, we'll refund you in full. No questions asked.
